title: Melbourne Subcortex Atlas — tian
text: tian_s1(): Scale , 8 structures per hemisphere: hippocampus, amygdala, nucleus accumbens, pallidum, putamen, caudate, thalamus split anterior posterior division. tian_s2(): Scale II, 16 structures per hemisphere. scale structure splits two, along anterior-posterior, medial-lateral core-shell axis. tian_s3(): Scale III, 25 structures per hemisphere. tian_s4(): Scale IV, 27 structures per hemisphere, finest parcellation published 3 Tesla data. tian_s1_7t(): Scale 7 Tesla data, 8 structures per hemisphere. tian_s2_7t(): Scale II 7 Tesla data, 17 structures per hemisphere. tian_s3_7t(): Scale III 7 Tesla data, 27 structures per hemisphere. tian_s4_7t(): Scale IV 7 Tesla data, 31 structures per hemisphere.
